---
title: "Page not found · Page introuvable"
---

::: {lang="en"}
The page you are looking for does not exist, or has moved.

Try the [home page](/), [research](/research/), or [CV](/cv/).
:::

::: {lang="fr"}
La page que vous cherchez n'existe pas ou a été déplacée.

Essayez la [page d'accueil](/fr/), la [recherche](/fr/research/) ou le [CV](/fr/cv/).
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// Legacy URL handler.
//
// The site used to live at capitalised paths (/About/, /CV/, /Media/,
// /Research/, /Teaching/) and at /Français/. Those are now lowercase, and
// French lives at /fr/.
//
// We cannot ship real redirect pages for the capitalised paths: GitHub Pages
// is case-sensitive when serving, but Windows is case-insensitive on disk, so
// the repo cannot contain both about/ and About/. GitHub Pages serves this
// 404 page for any unmatched path, so we do the redirect here instead.
//
// Caveat: this returns HTTP 404 before redirecting. Humans get where they are
// going; crawlers will treat the old URLs as gone. That is an accepted
// trade-off, documented in PLAN.md, Phase 2.
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var KEY = "legacy-redirect";
  var path = window.location.pathname;

  // Redirect at most once per target, so a genuinely missing page cannot
  // loop. Uses sessionStorage rather than a query marker so we do not leave
  // tracking-looking cruft on a URL that turns out to be valid.
  var store = null;
  try {
    store = window.sessionStorage;
  } catch (e) {
    /* private mode or blocked; fall through without loop protection */
  }

  if (store && store.getItem(KEY) === path) {
    store.removeItem(KEY);
    return;
  }

  var target = null;

  if (/^\/Français\/?$/i.test(path) || /^\/Fran%C3%A7ais\/?$/i.test(path)) {
    target = "/fr/";
  } else if (/^\/about(\/(index\.html)?)?$/i.test(path)) {
    // The About page was removed (its content lives on the home page).
    target = "/";
  } else if (/^\/fr\/about(\/(index\.html)?)?$/i.test(path)) {
    target = "/fr/";
  } else {
    var lowered = path.toLowerCase();
    if (lowered !== path) target = lowered;
  }

  if (target && target !== path) {
    if (store) store.setItem(KEY, target);
    window.location.replace(target);
  }
})();
</script>
```
